title: 7-day Northern Vietnam
description: The classic first week north of Hai Van: Hanoi’s Old Quarter and temples, Ninh Binh boats and Hang Mua, then a Ha Long / Bai Tu Long day on the water. Packed, not a cruise brochure — highest-ROI walks, markets, and one bay day.

title: 7-day Central coast
description: Hue’s citadel and tombs, Da Nang’s Marble Mountains and dragon river, Hoi An’s ancient town, lanterns, tailors, and An Bang. The DAD airport week everyone actually flies.
previewNames: Thủy Xuân Incense & Conical Hat Village
Thanh Toàn Tile-Roofed Bridge (Cầu Thanh Toàn)

title: 10-day Vietnam spine
description: The first-timer line Google keeps recommending: Hanoi streets and egg coffee, a Ninh Binh karst day, Hoi An heritage plus a Da Nang / Ba Na or Marble Mountains swing, then Saigon museums, Independence Palace, and Bến Thành. North to south, no filler islands.

title: 14-day Classic Vietnam
description: Two weeks the way desk agents still write it: Hanoi, Ha Long water, imperial Hue, lantern Hoi An (with Da Nang in reach), Saigon history, and a Mekong dawn at Cái Răng. Shopping sits on the evening markets — Đồng Xuân, Hội An tailors, Bến Thành — not as an afterthought.

title: 14-day Nature & heritage
description: Mountains before museums: Hanoi launch, Sapa terraces and Fansipan, Ninh Binh boats, Phong Nha cave country, then Hoi An to land. Built from the sights travellers actually rank — not a 4×4 brochure dump.

title: 21-day Grand Vietnam
description: Three weeks, north to island: Hanoi, the Hà Giang loop, Ninh Binh, Phong Nha, Hue, Hoi An / Da Nang, Da Lat pines, Saigon, then Phú Quốc to finish. Packed days, shopping markets included, timing from the same engine as Your Itinerary.
